verdict.rationale: Veo is documented on the Gemini API developer docs (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/video), including multi-turn refinement through the Interactions API. Community reports of paying through a paid API and GCP credits corroborate programmatic access. A migration notice tells users to move to Gemini Omni Flash or the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform to avoid service interruptions, and probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt on ai.google.dev. missing for 10: endpoint/parameter-level API reference in the evidence, a published OpenAPI spec, clarity on long-term API availability given the migration/deprecation notice.
